patch_list: Removes every ad (AdMob) and every tracker (Firebase Analytics, AppsFlyer, Facebook, TikTok, and the Veridium SDK's own Google Analytics) — event sends, full SDK init (AppsFlyer init, TikTok initializeSdk/startTrack, MobileAds.initialize),…

Claim MyZong's daily reward with no 'watch ad' popup and no ad. Forces the reward-bubble tap to take the app's own direct-claim branch (the same claim call the post-ad path makes), upstream of both the popup and the rewarded ad.
